name: vscode-esi-mcp
description: Direct local HTTP MCP server for VS Code terminals, debugging, C# Dev Kit, and Microsoft Access MCP operations.
author: sidatacom

esimcp.debugAdapterTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for debug adapter requests in milliseconds

esimcp.debugStateTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for debug state changes in milliseconds

esimcp.debugReadyString.description: Text observed in terminal or Debug Console output by the debug host readiness check

esimcp.debugHostReadinessUrl.description: Optional HTTP or HTTPS URL to probe while waiting for debug host readiness

esimcp.terminalPollIntervalMs.description: Interval for polling terminal completion in milliseconds

esimcp.terminalCompletionSettleMs.description: Quiet period used to settle terminal completion in milliseconds

esimcp.terminalStartupDelayMs.description: Delay before sending the first command to a newly created terminal in milliseconds

esimcp.idleReaperIntervalMs.description: Interval for checking idle terminal sessions in milliseconds

esimcp.bindHost.description: Loopback hosts for the direct EsiMCP HTTP server

esimcp.blockedCommands.description: Commands that are never allowed to execute

esimcp.defaultTimeoutMs.description: Default timeout for command execution in milliseconds

esimcp.maxConcurrentSessions.description: Maximum number of concurrent terminal sessions

esimcp.includeAllTerminals.description: When enabled, expose all currently open VS Code terminals as EsiMCP sessions after activation or reload

esimcp.maxOutputLines.description: Maximum number of output lines to buffer per session

esimcp.idleTimeoutMs.description: Auto-close idle sessions after this many milliseconds (0 = disabled)

esimcp.msAccessServerCommand.description: Command used to start the Microsoft Access MCP server

esimcp.msAccessServerArguments.description: Arguments for the Microsoft Access MCP server; empty uses the bundled submodule project

esimcp.msAccessServerProject.description: Relative or absolute project path used by the default dotnet server command

esimcp.msAccessServerWorkingDirectory.description: Working directory for the Microsoft Access MCP server

esimcp.msAccessDatabasePath.description: Optional Access database path passed through ACCESS_DATABASE_PATH

esimcp.msAccessTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for Microsoft Access MCP requests in milliseconds
